component.name: M. ASSAHTOUT TV
component.summary: Custom native desktop and TV streaming client

description.p: M. ASSAHTOUT TV is a custom-built native desktop and TV streaming client powered by Rust and hardware-accelerated playback without ads, browsers, or tracking.

ul.li: Home, Shorts, subscriptions, channels, playlists, search and live streams
Built-in SponsorBlock, DeArrow titles and thumbnails, and Return YouTube Dislike
Background play, picture-in-picture, downloads and audio-only mode
Local subscriptions and history stored privately on your device
